fields.Name: Video Studio Draft
fields.Description: Fast draft configuration for Video Studio: Gemini 3.8 Flash at low effort, 0 repair rounds, 24 fps draft render of the first format only, up to 20s of generated footage.

fields.Name: VideoStudio.MaxRepairRounds
fields.Description: Maximum Critic-to-Motion-Engineer repair rounds after initial render (0 in Draft).

fields.Name: VideoStudio.RenderQuality

fields.Description: Frames per second for rendered deliverables.

fields.Name: VideoStudio.Formats
fields.Description: Whether to render only Film.Formats[0] ('First') or every requested format ('All').

fields.Name: VideoStudio.GenerationQuality
fields.Description: Model quality tier for generative image and video clips (draft | standard | high).

fields.Name: VideoStudio.MaxRegenerations
fields.Description: Maximum times a single generated asset may be regenerated during Critic repair.
